# Install

<Tabs groupId="os">
  <TabItem value="mac" label="macOS" default>
    Install with Homebrew:

    ```bash
    brew install acme
    if [ -n "$CI" ]; then
      acme --version
    fi
    ```

    Then run `acme init`.
  </TabItem>
  <TabItem value="win" label={"Windows"}>
